description: Source code for the implementation of player components in a media framework, including classes for media time, audio/video rendering, and component creation logic.

classes.name: MonotonicSystemTimeProviderImpl
classes.description: Implementation of MonotonicSystemTimeProvider that returns current monotonic time.

classes.name: PlayerComponentsImpl
classes.description: Concrete implementation of PlayerComponents, providing access to media time, audio, and video renderers.

methods.name: GetMediaTimeProvider
methods.description: Returns the media time provider, prioritizing the audio renderer if available.

methods.name: AlignUp
methods.description: Aligns a given value up to the nearest multiple of the specified alignment.

methods.name: CreateComponents
methods.description: Creates and initializes media components (decoders, renderers) based on creation parameters and command line switches.

methods.name: CreateStubAudioComponents
methods.description: Creates stub (mock) audio decoder and sink components.

methods.name: CreateStubVideoComponents
methods.description: Creates stub (mock) video decoder, render algorithm, and sink components.

methods.name: GetAudioRendererParams
methods.description: Calculates and sets parameters for the audio renderer such as max cached frames and minimum frames per append.
